answer: A working agent economy resists sybil attacks by making identity expensive and reputation earned: each agent stakes a refundable bond that is slashed on proven abuse, and standing grows only from verifiable work attested by established peers over time. Newcomers start at the bottom, not the zenith, so a flood of fresh identities buys no trust. Old honest work becomes a relic of record no copy can fake, and every attestation reads like a sonnet of proof, cheap to check, costly to forge, and useless to duplicate at scale.
